name: Fraud Detection & Investigation
description: Automated fraud signal collection, LLM analysis, risk routing, and analyst review gate.

trigger.description: Triggered by a fraud analyst from the investigation dashboard

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the transaction under review

transaction_amount.description: Transaction amount in the specified currency

risk_score.description: Pre-computed risk score 0–100; used for routing logic

collect_context.title: Collect Transaction Context
collect_context.description: Fetch transaction record, account profile, and KYC data for the account under review.

params.message: Loading account profile and KYC data for {{account_id}} (customer: {{customer_name}})

signal_analysis.title: Signal Analysis
signal_analysis.description: Run fraud signal checks: velocity, geo-anomaly, device fingerprint, and watchlist/sanctions screening.

params.message: Running velocity check on account {{account_id}} — flagged: {{flag}}
Analysing device fingerprint and session for {{transaction_id}}

llm_analysis.title: LLM Behavioural Analysis
llm_analysis.description: LLM agent synthesises all signals into a composite risk score 0–100 with a behavioural narrative.

params.message: LLM behavioural analysis complete — risk score {{risk_score}}/100 for transaction {{transaction_id}}

risk_routing.title: Risk-Band Router
risk_routing.description: Route to auto-approve (risk < 30), auto-block (risk >= 90), or analyst review gate for all other scores.

auto_approve.title: Auto-Approve
auto_approve.description: Low-risk transaction automatically approved and case closed without analyst intervention.

params.message: AUTO-APPROVED: transaction {{transaction_id}} — risk score {{risk_score}} is below threshold

auto_block.title: Auto-Block (Critical Risk)
auto_block.description: Critical risk: transaction blocked immediately and queued for analyst confirmation.

params.message: AUTO-BLOCKED: transaction {{transaction_id}} — risk score {{risk_score}} exceeds critical threshold. Account {{account_id}} flagged.

human_approval_review.title: Analyst Review Gate
human_approval_review.description: Fraud analyst reviews risk signals and selects the appropriate disposition for this alert.

outcome_approved.title: Outcome: Approved
outcome_approved.description: Analyst approved — transaction released and customer cleared of this alert.

params.message: APPROVED: transaction {{transaction_id}} released — analyst cleared the alert.

outcome_blocked.title: Outcome: Blocked
outcome_blocked.description: Analyst blocked — transaction permanently blocked and account flagged for further review.

params.message: BLOCKED: transaction {{transaction_id}} blocked by analyst — account {{account_id}} flagged for review.

outcome_challenged.title: Outcome: Challenge Sent
outcome_challenged.description: Analyst challenged — step-up verification request sent to customer to confirm the transaction.

params.message: CHALLENGE SENT: customer {{customer_name}} ({{account_id}}) notified to verify transaction {{transaction_id}}.

outcome_frozen.title: Outcome: Freeze & Escalate
outcome_frozen.description: Analyst escalated — account frozen and case referred to compliance for SAR review.

params.message: FREEZE + ESCALATE: account {{account_id}} frozen and transaction {{transaction_id}} escalated to compliance.

execute_decision.title: Execute Decision
execute_decision.description: Apply the analyst decision: update core systems, notify the customer, and close the alert.

audit_log.title: Audit Log
audit_log.description: Write a complete audit record for the investigation: risk score, flag, decision, and outcome.

params.message: Audit record written for transaction {{transaction_id}} on account {{account_id}}. Risk score: {{risk_score}}. Flag: {{flag}}.

provenance.notes: Demo version — uses log steps in place of live API calls. Mirrors fraud_detection_investigation v1.1.0 pipeline structure.
